text:
Maria (Finance): FYI — ACME Corp invoice INV-2025-004 is overdue. They called saying procurement won't release payment without a PO. Card on file also declined earlier today. They've threatened to dispute any suspension. Can we pause dunning?

Kevin (AE): Got them on the phone. Buyer says PO is in their system but needs our vendor details and VAT invoice. Asking for 48h for PO, insists charge should go through once PO issued. High-touch customer.

Jess (Billing): Adding details: amount €48,200. Due 2026-03-12. Payment attempt 03/15 declined: decline_code=do_not_honor, last4=4242. VAT field mismatch flagged for EU tax.

Tom (CS): They said legal is pushing for no suspension while procurement sorts PO. Can we grant a short extension? Would like to avoid impacting product availability.

Maria (Finance): Our standard dunning: notice -> 7-day followup -> suspension. We're at notice 3. Policy allows a discretionary 7-day hold if AE confirms active PO process. Need sign-off from Billing.

Jess (Billing): We can hold suspension for 7 days provided they submit a formal PO and we receive a valid payment method or cleared PO. I'll update ledger status to "pending PO".

Kevin (AE): I'll email procurement contact and send vendor fields now. Sharing the PO template they need: https://company.share/po-template (sent to buyer).

Maria (Finance): QA checklist for the PO: vendor name must match "Redwood Inference, Inc.", VAT number: GB999999973, remit to: invoices@redwood.ai, payment terms net30. If any field missing, we can't mark invoice paid.

Jess (Billing): Also we need the tax VAT line clarified. ACME is EU-based; we need their VAT ID for reverse charge handling. If absent, we have to charge VAT which they dispute.

Tom (CS): Could we offer a temporary read-only throttle instead of full suspension so product stays up but usage limited? That might reduce customer pain while finance finishes.

Maria (Finance): Good idea. Ops — @dunning-bot, set action: defer suspension 7 days for INV-2025-004 and flag ledger as pending_proof_of_po.

Dunning-bot: Action recorded: suspension deferred 7 days for INV-2025-004. Next automated reminder scheduled in 3 days. Note: manual override allowed by Billing.

Jess (Billing): I'll prepare the VAT explanation and a short invoice addendum we can send to procurement to speed this up. Kevin, can you copy procurement email thread into billing@redwood.ai?

Kevin (AE): On it. Forwarding thread now.

Maria (Finance): One more: if card declines repeatedly, payment gateway may flag risk. Jess, can you also request a manual auth attempt once PO arrives? We should try re-authorization before forcing other collection steps.

Jess (Billing): Will do. I'll schedule a manual auth and monitor. If they still don't provide PO or payment in the 7-day window, we revert to standard suspension and escalate to collections.

Tom (CS): I'll notify the customer success lead to prepare customer comms and offer the throttle workaround.

Kevin (AE): Thanks all. I'll push for PO today and update here. :thumbsup:

Maria (Finance): Thanks. Keeping thread open until PO or payment received.
